score_interpretation.A: Fuzzy (all features): temperature-scaled normalised fuzzy rule scores (not calibrated probabilities); scalar temperature fitted from grouped OOF training scores
score_interpretation.B: Rough Set + Fuzzy: temperature-scaled normalised fuzzy rule scores (not calibrated probabilities); scalar temperature fitted from grouped OOF training scores
score_interpretation.C1: Random Forest: temperature-scaled Random Forest class probability estimates (not post-hoc calibrated); scalar temperature fitted from grouped OOF training scores
score_interpretation.C2: SVM (RBF): temperature-scaled softmax-transformed SVM decision ranking scores (not calibrated probabilities); scalar temperature fitted from grouped OOF training scores

score_calibration.calibration_scope: training records only; held-out test records are not used to fit temperature
score_calibration.oof_imputation: fold-specific medians fitted only on each fold's training records
limitations: Temperature was fitted to grouped out-of-fold training scores and then applied to the final model fit on all training records.
Held-out test reliability must still be inspected; this is internal calibration, not external or clinical validation.
Calibration can be unstable when a class is represented by only a few training records or beats.

score_reliability.score_semantics: temperature-scaled normalised fuzzy rule scores (not calibrated probabilities); scalar temperature fitted from grouped OOF training scores
score_reliability.normalisation: each score row divided by its non-negative row sum; all-zero rows replaced by uniform scores
score_reliability.interpretation: These diagnostics evaluate the supplied score vectors on untouched held-out labels; no transform is fitted here. When available, the upstream temperature was fitted only from grouped out-of-fold training records. Internal calibration is not external or clinical validation, and score semantics remain model-specific.

detection_metrics.evaluation_note: Classification metrics use only detected beats matched one-to-one to reference annotations; FP/FN are reported separately here.

disclaimer: Academic research prototype. Outputs are NOT medically validated and must NOT be used for clinical diagnosis or treatment decisions.
notes: Strict patient-disjoint runs exclude record 202 because records 201 and 202 belong to the same subject; historical compatibility mode explicitly allows that overlap.
In automatic-detection mode, classifier metrics are conditional on detected beats matched one-to-one to reference beats; detector FP/FN are reported separately.
Fuzzy normalised scores and SVM ranking scores are not calibrated clinical probabilities.
Record-cluster bootstrap intervals resample held-out records, not individual beats; they are descriptive uncertainty summaries.

Patient-cluster bootstrap intervals and per-patient metrics are also reported when patient identifiers are available (record identifiers are used as a documented fallback); these summaries describe held-out patient heterogeneity and are not external validation.

The feature pipeline is offline / retrospective: zero-phase filtering, record-level R-amplitude scaling and next-RR features use full-record or future-beat context; it is not a validated streaming detector.
A single MIT-BIH split is not external validation or clinical validation.

When grouped training records support it, scalar temperature scaling is fitted only from grouped out-of-fold training scores; fold-specific imputation is fitted within each fold. The untouched test split is used only for evaluation. This is internal calibration, not external or clinical validation.

Held-out score reliability diagnostics (Brier, log loss and ECE) are computed after the training-only transform. Fuzzy and SVM outputs remain model score estimates and must not be interpreted as clinical risk probabilities.
Global feature summaries are model-native importance or fuzzy-rule usage summaries; they are not causal effects.
